thread:
dario: Quick heads-up — canary for new prefix-dedup cache finished, numbers look solid :tada:

sahana: Nice! summary stats?

dario: p50 latency down ~11%, p95 down ~18%, p99 down ~22% on gen workload A (seq~256). Token compute cost ~7% lower. Cache hit 28% -> 61% on canary slice.

kiara: Which clients saw biggest gains?

dario: Reuse-heavy chat flows and instruction-following apps. Mobile assistant demos had biggest tail wins.

leo: Any risk of stale KV or cross-user leakage?

dario: We dedup only identical prefix hashes and within a short TTL. KV keys include request-id + prefix-hash, no cross-user leakage. Dedup disabled for ephemeral tokens.

bench-bot: Canary: 24h, 5% traffic, env=prod-canary. 95th pct GPU CPU -15%, mem ~unchanged, avg latency -12%. Full report: https://redwood-internal/bench/reports/1865432100

kiara: How validated for correctness?

dario: Ran functional parity, sampling divergence (KL), and human eval on 400 samples. No regressions. Added regression alert for similarity thresholds.

ops-bot: Canary deploy completed ✅ — auto-fallback guard if p99 >10% vs baseline.

sahana: Rollout plan?

dario: Ramp 5% → 25% → 50% → 100% over 72h with automated checks at each step. Eng-sre watching.

kiara: Config knobs for Dedicated customers?

dario: Expose route flags: prefix_dedup_enabled (bool) and dedup_ttl_ms (int). Default on, opt-out available.

leo: Need short blurb for release notes and sales about cost impact.

dario: Draft: "~7% token compute reduction on reuse-heavy workloads; typical p95 latency improvements 10–20%" — will share in #marketing-launch.

sahana: Can we add a dashboard tile for dedup hitrate and savings?

dario: Yes — new Runtime Overview panels: "Prefix Dedup Hitrate" and "Dedup Savings (tokens)" plus alert if hitrate drops >20% vs rolling 7d.

kiara: Any routes where it didn't help?

dario: Stateless routes with unique prefixes saw no gain. Saw small jitter on cold KV shards; fixed via prewarming.

leo: Sounds safe. Ping eng-oncall for 25% ramp.

dario: Patch merged main@a3f9d. Config snippet for ops:

```
# runtime config
prefix_dedup:
  enabled: true
  dedup_ttl_ms: 5000
  sample_rate: 1.0
```

bench-bot: Scheduled full-rollout baseline comparison job at 1865510000 for final numbers.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert set: runtime/prefix_dedup/p99_delta > 10% -> auto-fallback.

sahana: Need 2 slides for all-hands tomorrow. dario?

dario: Yep, slides + short demo in #all-hands by EOD.

kiara: :clap:

leo: Great work, team.
